accel_embedder:_ensure_ref_main.reason: Writes the pinned Hugging Face revision id to the model cache's refs/main, as bytes with no line ending.

build_pack:_run_release_orchestration.reason: Writes the release notes and SHA256SUMS of a release build as UTF-8 and ASCII bytes with LF endings.

build_pack:write_manifest.writer_callers_reason: Writes the pack MANIFEST it computes from its own entries; _build_zip_body orchestrates the pack build.

build_pack:write_pack_version.writer_callers_reason: Writes the pack VERSION from its own arguments at a fixed path; _build_zip_body orchestrates the pack build.

bytecode_cache:_flush_if_stale.reason: Writes the bytecode cache version stamp as bytes with no line ending.

contained_files:_write_all.reason: Implements the contained_files.write_contained_bytes primitive: writes caller bytes to an already opened descriptor.

contained_files:open_contained_append.reason: Implements the contained append primitive for child-process and upgrade logs; returns the open text handle.

dashboard_server:_daemonize.reason: Opens the dashboard daemon's process log for the child's output.

dashboard_server:_dashboard_log.reason: Appends a line to the local dashboard process log.

docs_gardener:refresh_last_verified.reason: Replaces the date inside the existing Last verified line of the raw document text (Requirement 4).

embedded_model_bundle:retain.reason: Copies a model bundle archive verbatim (binary).
embedded_model_bundle:retain.writer_callers_reason: Retains the bundle archive at its own fixed path from the archive the incoming runner opened; the runner orchestrates the upgrade.

graph_quality_eval:materialize.newline_unset_reason: The shipped baseline and post reports pin this evaluator's source hash and builder provenance; regenerating them would rewrite the historical post report, so the scratch corpus write is left unchanged (wave 244in).
graph_quality_eval:materialize.reason: Materializes the graph-quality evaluation corpus into a scratch root for one evaluation run; nothing is committed or edited in place.

index_state_store:store_log.reason: Local index process log: trims the log tail as bytes and appends a line.

memory_records:rebuild_archive_manifest.writer_callers_reason: Regenerates the archive register from the archive bodies at its fixed path after archive_memory_record moves a body.

model_bundle:_normalize_refs_in_place.reason: Rewrites a model cache ref to its 40-byte revision id, with no line ending.
model_bundle:_normalize_refs_in_place.writer_callers_reason: Normalizes the cache refs under the bundle destination it is given; attest_online_cache and materialize_bundle are the two model-cache steps that own that destination.

model_bundle:attest_online_cache.writer_callers_reason: Writes its own model-cache marker; setup_index.main orchestrates setup.

model_bundle:materialize_bundle.reason: Writes model payload files verbatim (binary) and an LF JSON marker with newline set to LF.
model_bundle:materialize_bundle.writer_callers_reason: Materializes the model bundle at the destination materialize_source stages; both are model-cache steps.

model_bundle:materialize_source.reason: Stages a downloaded model archive verbatim (binary).
model_bundle:materialize_source.writer_callers_reason: Stages the model archive at its own path; setup_index.main orchestrates setup.

render_agent_surfaces:_move_prompt_pair.reason: Moves a prompt file to its new name with its own bytes; a replaced line keeps the ending of the line it replaces.

render_agent_surfaces:migrate_change_pro.reason: Moves a prompt file to its new name with its own bytes; a replaced line keeps the ending of the line it replaces.

render_agent_surfaces:migrate_council_ro.reason: Splices link destinations inside existing lines of the raw document text (Requirement 4).

render_agent_surfaces:migrate_lifecycle_.reason: Splices link destinations inside existing lines of the raw document text (Requirement 4).

render_agent_surfaces:migrate_review_pla.reason: Moves a prompt file to its new name with its own bytes; a replaced line keeps the ending of the line it replaces.

render_agent_surfaces:reconcile_lifecycl.writer_callers_reason: Creates missing prompt baselines from templates; render_agent_surfaces orchestrates the render.

render_agent_surfaces:reconcile_scaffold.writer_callers_reason: Creates missing scaffold baselines from templates; render_agent_surfaces orchestrates the render.

render_agent_surfaces:render_skills.writer_callers_reason: Renders the skill documents it owns; render_agent_surfaces orchestrates the render.

render_platform_surfaces:render_bin_laun.writer_callers_reason: Renders the bin launchers it owns; main orchestrates the render.

repair_ppol_memory_staging:apply_repair.reason: Restores staged memory files from a repair kit verbatim as bytes.

review_policy_reconcile:reconcile_lifecy.merged_by_reason: Publishes the carrier edits plan_reconciliation planned as line_endings.merge of each carrier as read.

review_policy_upgrade:apply_review_polic.merged_by_reason: Publishes the preflighted plan, whose config, carrier and wave bytes plan_review_policy_upgrade planned as line_endings.merge of each file as read; the byte checks compare those bytes.

run_tests:_acquire_run_lock.reason: Opens the test runner's lock file; its content is an LF pid line.

runtime_lock:_open_carrier.dynamic_mode_reason: The mode argument is always a+b or r+b (docstring and both callers).
runtime_lock:_open_carrier.reason: Opens a binary lock carrier (mode a+b or r+b).

scanner_upgrade:_stage.put.reason: Copies scanner archive members verbatim (binary) into a staging tree.

scanner_upgrade:inspect_project_rules.reason: Copies the project's scanner rule file bytes verbatim into a scratch tree for inspection.

setup_index:_install_pinned_uv.reason: Writes a temporary pip requirements file of one LF-terminated line as bytes; deleted after use.

setup_index:_spawn_background_semantic_b.reason: Opens the background build's process log for the child's output and writes its pid file.

sqlite_storage_migration:_fsync_file.reason: Opens a file r+b only to fsync it; writes nothing.

sqlite_storage_migration:_write.writer_callers_reason: Writes the migration receipt at its fixed path with the receipt its callers build; retire_prestaging_noop is the same module's step.

upgrade_bridge_bootstrap:_retain_feature.reason: Copies the feature pack archive verbatim (binary).
upgrade_bridge_bootstrap:_retain_feature.writer_callers_reason: Retains the feature pack at its own fixed path; install orchestrates the bridge install.

upgrade_bundle:_incoming_runner.reason: Extracts the incoming runner's pack members verbatim (binary).

upgrade_extensions:_extract_preview_scri.reason: Copies pack zip member bytes verbatim into a preview scratch tree.

upgrade_extensions:_legacy_lock_is_held.reason: Opens a legacy lock r+b only to probe whether it is held; writes nothing.

upgrade_extensions:_migrate_journal_entr.reason: Moves a vetted journal entry's bytes verbatim to its new location through _write_journal_exclusive; no line is edited.

upgrade_extensions:_move_journal_at.reason: Moves a vetted journal entry's bytes verbatim to its new location through _write_journal_exclusive; no line is edited.

upgrade_extensions:_update_upgrade_state.writer_callers_reason: Rewrites the machine-owned upgrade-in-progress.json state file; _reconcile_docs_scalar_claims records its progress there.

upgrade_protocol:_validate_mandatory_imp.reason: Copies pack member bytes verbatim into a validation scratch tree.

upgrade_wavefoundry:_print_change_plan.writer_callers_reason: Writes the upgrade review log for the plan it prints; phase_dry_run orchestrates the dry run.

upgrade_wavefoundry:_stage_pack_for_cons.reason: Copies the binary pack zip verbatim.

upgrade_wavefoundry:phase_pruning.reason: Writes the pre-upgrade MANIFEST snapshot text, already read, back as UTF-8 bytes unchanged to a temporary file.

wave_work:_write_owner.reason: Writes the work-area owner record as compact JSON bytes with no line ending.

wave_work:publish_snapshot.reason: Writes the review snapshot as compact JSON bytes with no line ending.
wave_work:publish_snapshot.writer_callers_reason: Publishes the review snapshot JSON it builds, at its own work-area path; _publish_prepare_policy_state calls it after the receipt commits.

wf_server.index_handlers:run_index_rebui.reason: Opens the rebuild's process log for the child's output and writes its state file.

wf_server.memory_handlers:memory_consoli.reason: Rollback restores the exact original record and manifest bytes it read before the consolidation.

wf_server.server_impl:_mark_change_item_.reason: Marks a checkbox and appends a status note inside the existing lines of the raw document text; the note takes the document's own ending.
